out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: The quaternary ammonia sanitizer concentration for the wiping cloth buckets was 0 ppm. This was due to the issues with the quaternary ammonia dispenser not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The manager corrected this by replacing all the sanitizer solutions after the quaternary ammonia sanitizer dispenser was repaired. The solutions were 200 ppm quaternary ammonia.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please e-mail the Health Department by 11/21/2024 with the receipt for the temperature indicator.
